blocks.title: Introduction
blocks.content:
Let $K$ be a knot and $J_N(K;t)$ be the colored Jones polynomial of $K$ in the three-sphere $S^3$ corresponding to the $N$-dimensional representation of $sl_2(\mathbb{C})$ (see for example [@Kirby/Melvin:INVEM91]). We normalize it so that $J_N(\text{unknot};t)=1$.

In [@Kashaev:LETMP97], R. Kashaev introduced a series of numerical link invariants and proposed a conjecture that a limit of his invariants would determines the hyperbolic volume of the complement of a knot if it has a complete hyperbolic structure. arXiv:math/0401084v3  [math.GT]  9 Mar 2006
THE COLORED JONES POLYNOMIALS OF THE
FIGURE-EIGHT KNOT AND ITS DEHN SURGERY SPACES
HITOSHI MURAKAMI AND YOSHIYUKI YOKOTA
Abstract. We calculate limits of the colored Jones polynomials of the ﬁgure-
eight knot and conclude that in most cases they determine the volumes and
the Chern–Simons invariants of the three-manifolds obtained by Dehn surgeries
along it.

blocks.title: Main result
blocks.content:
To state our main result we recall some of the results in [@Neumann/Zagier:TOPOL85; @Yoshida:INVEM85].

Let $K$ be a hyperbolic knot in the three-sphere $S^3$, that is, the complement $S^3\setminus{K}$ has a complete hyperbolic structure. The complete hyperbolic structure can be deformed by a complex parameter $u$ that is the logarithm of the ratio of the eigenvalues of the image of the meridian $K$ by the holonomy representation $\pi_1(S^3\setminus{K})\to\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{C})$.
